chunks: Yet no sign of their Lord comes to them but they turn away from it.
ai.seo_question: Why do people turn away from divine signs even when they are presented to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-An'am is often linked to the concept of *'ismah* (infallibility) of the Ahl al-Bayt, contrasting their receptive hearts with the stubbornness of the disbelievers who possess the same signs yet remain *mu'ridun* (turning away). It emphasizes that mere exposure to divine evidence is insufficient without the spiritual readiness to accept it, a theme central to the Shia understanding of prophetic authority and the Quran as a living sign. This persistent rejection serves as a precursor to the eventual divine punishment, illustrating the consequence of willful ignorance despite clear guidance.
